product_decision: The in-app popup "Kifurushi kimekwisha" must NEVER be shown again.
backend_role: Always emit suppress_expiry_popup=true on verify + subscription-stream. Access denial remains authoritative via active/playbackAllowed.
app_role: Never present Kifurushi kimekwisha for any verify/SSE inactive/expired/revoked/null payload. Trust suppress_expiry_popup / expiry_popup_policy=never. Account renew UI and playback gates may still reflect inactive.

authoritativeInactive.meaning: Access state is authoritative (do not treat as transient DB glitch). Does NOT authorize showing the expiry popup.

active.note: Still false when expired/revoked/missing — playback authorization preserved

inactive_reason.note: Informational only; never gate the Kifurushi kimekwisha modal

before.suppress_expiry_popup: true only when admin_revoked; missing on null subscription rows
before.app_effect: Natural expiry / never-subscribed verify responses triggered Kifurushi kimekwisha

after.app_effect: No Kifurushi kimekwisha from backend responses or SSE snapshots
